brief.meaningEn: Having practical control over decisions and the direction of events.
brief.meaningZh: 實際掌握決策與事態方向。
brief.grammar: Have/keep one’s hands on the wheel is a driving metaphor; possessive agrees with the person or group controlling decisions.
brief.register: Crisis-planning discussion: a community coordinator explains which team can change the evacuation timetable rather than merely comment on it.
brief.boundaryZh: 掌握局面指有實際決策權，不等於能保證結果完美或獨自負責所有工作。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是必須開車，也不能把只提供意見的人說成直接操控者。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出誰有權改變安排、誰只是建議，以及控制不等於保證成功。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 70, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Officials have their hands on the wheel during a crisis.

listening.en: During the flood warning, the operations team could change bus routes and assign drivers without waiting for another committee. It had its hands on the wheel.
listening.zh: 洪水警告期間，行動隊毋須等另一委員會批准，便可更改巴士路線和調配司機，直接掌握局面。
listening.promptZh: had its hands on the wheel 表示甚麼？

options.en: The team held practical decision-making control.
options.zh: 團隊有實際決策控制權。

options.en: The team could only submit suggestions for later approval.
options.zh: 團隊只能提交建議，等待日後批准。

options.en: The team guaranteed that no route would ever fail.
options.zh: 團隊保證沒有路線會出錯。

options.en: Every team member was physically driving a bus.
options.zh: 每名隊員都在實際駕駛巴士。

listening.explanationZh: 能直接更改路線和調配司機，支持實際掌控，而非只提意見。

reply.promptEn: Who is steering the festival schedule? The student committee can approve timetable changes and move volunteers today; the sponsor may advise but cannot veto those changes.
reply.promptZh: （誰在掌握節慶時間表？學生委員會今天可批准時間改動並調動義工；贊助者可提意見，但不能否決改動。）

options.en: The student committee can make the operative changes.
options.zh: 學生委員會可以作出實際改動。

options.en: The sponsor advises, while the committee decides.
options.zh: 贊助者提供意見，委員會作決定。

options.en: The student committee has its hands on the wheel.
options.zh: 學生委員會直接掌握安排。

options.en: Timetable authority rests with the student committee.
options.zh: 時間表的決定權在學生委員會。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以批准及調動權識別掌控者；金句用 hands on the wheel。

scene.promptZh: 一間中心的主管可即時調整開放時間和人手；顧問只提交建議。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The manager has her hands on the wheel, while the advisers only recommend changes.
options.zh: 主管直接掌握安排，顧問只是提出建議。

options.en: The advisers alone decide every opening hour.
options.zh: 只有顧問能決定所有開放時間。

options.en: The manager can guarantee that no visitor will ever wait.
options.zh: 主管能保證訪客永遠不用等候。

scene.explanationZh: 實際調整權在主管，而非顧問。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 someone has their hands on the wheel？

options.en: A team can redirect deliveries when a road closes.
options.zh: 道路封閉時，團隊可更改送貨路線。

options.en: A spectator can watch updates but cannot alter any decision.
options.zh: 旁觀者可看更新，卻不能改動任何決定。

options.en: A manager can reassign staff during a disruption.
options.zh: 出現中斷時，經理可重新分配人手。

contrast.explanationZh: 旁觀者沒有決策權，並非掌握局面。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「負責隊伍雙手掌舵，就保證活動不會出錯。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Having their hands on the wheel means they can direct decisions, not guarantee a perfect outcome.
options.zh: 直接掌握安排表示可作決策，不保證結果完美。

options.en: Control always prevents every unexpected problem.
options.zh: 有控制權就必然避免所有意外問題。

options.en: If a team delegates tasks, it cannot make decisions.
options.zh: 團隊只要分工，就不可能作決定。

dialogue.explanationZh: 控制的是決策權，不是所有未來結果。

speaking.en: The local organisers kept their hands on the wheel by approving route changes themselves while accepting safety advice.
speaking.zh: 本地籌辦人自行批准路線改動，同時聽取安全建議，保持對安排的直接掌握。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出他們保留了哪項權限。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園市集遇上暴雨，學生委員會有權即時把攤位移入禮堂並調整義工崗位；校長提供安全建議，但毋須逐項批准。用一至兩句英文說明誰直接掌握安排，不要保證天氣問題完全解決。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出學生委員會可自行移動攤位與調動義工、校長只提供建議，並避免保證完美結果。

examples.en: The student committee has its hands on the wheel: it can move stalls into the hall and reassign volunteers, while the principal only offers safety advice.
examples.zh: 學生委員會直接掌握安排：可以把攤位移入禮堂並重新分配義工，校長則只提供安全建議。

examples.en: With its hands on the wheel, the committee can change stall locations and volunteer roles during the storm; the principal advises but need not approve each move.
examples.zh: 學生委員會在暴雨中直接掌握安排，可更改攤位位置和義工崗位；校長提供建議，毋須逐項批准。

takeaways.en: Hands on the wheel means direct control over decisions.
takeaways.zh: 直接掌握局面，指擁有實際決策權。

takeaways.en: Keeping hands on the wheel does not guarantee every outcome will be perfect.
takeaways.zh: 保留掌控權不保證每個結果都完美。

brief.meaningEn: Become a prominent news story, usually attracting conspicuous media attention.
brief.meaningZh: 成為備受注目的新聞題材。
brief.grammar: An event/person makes or made headlines; the phrase describes news prominence, not whether coverage is positive or true.
brief.register: Neutral media briefing: a school communications officer tells colleagues that a remarkable student result led several outlets to feature the story prominently.
brief.boundaryZh: 備受報道不代表每個媒體都報道，也不等於消息必然正面或已核實。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是自己製作印刷標題；也不是只在一篇文章角落被提及。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨顯眼的新聞焦點與普通提及，並避免把曝光率當成真偽或好壞判斷。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 70, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A record win can make headlines.

listening.en: A student-built water filter won an international prize, and several local papers put the achievement in prominent stories. The win made headlines.
listening.zh: 學生製作的濾水器獲國際獎項，幾份本地報章顯眼報道。這次獲獎成為焦點新聞。
listening.promptZh: made headlines 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The win became a prominent news story.
options.zh: 這次獲獎成為顯眼新聞。

options.en: One paper mentioned the win only in an unrelated footnote.
options.zh: 一份報章只在無關的註腳提及獲獎。

options.en: The papers placed the achievement only in small unrelated links.
options.zh: 報章只把這項成就放在不起眼的無關連結。

options.en: Coverage proves every claim about the filter is correct.
options.zh: 有報道就證明濾水器的每項聲稱都正確。

listening.explanationZh: 幾份報章顯眼報道，支持成為新聞焦點；並不證明所有產品聲稱。

reply.promptEn: Why did the museum prepare a press statement? Its newly restored film appeared as the lead cultural story on several news sites, prompting public questions.
reply.promptZh: （博物館為何準備新聞聲明？新修復的電影成為多個新聞網站的文化版首要報道，引來公眾提問。）

options.en: The restoration attracted conspicuous media coverage.
options.zh: 修復工作吸引顯眼報道。

options.en: Several outlets featured the film prominently.
options.zh: 多個媒體顯眼介紹該電影。

options.en: The restored film made headlines.
options.zh: 修復電影成為焦點新聞。

options.en: The museum needed to respond to increased public attention.
options.zh: 博物館需要回應增加的公眾關注。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都根據首要報道與提問說明關注度；金句用 made headlines。

scene.promptZh: 一名跑手破了紀錄，多家報章把她放在體育版顯眼位置。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Her record-breaking run made headlines.
options.zh: 她破紀錄的表現成為焦點新聞。

options.en: Her result appeared only in one private training log.
options.zh: 她的成績只記在一份私人訓練日誌。

options.en: The coverage guarantees she will win every future race.
options.zh: 報道保證她日後每場賽事都會勝出。

scene.explanationZh: 顯眼的多家報道符合 make headlines，卻不保證未來成績。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 the event made headlines？

options.en: The event leads the evening news on several channels.
options.zh: 事件登上多個頻道晚間新聞頭條。

options.en: One visitor writes about it only in a private diary.
options.zh: 只有一名訪客在私人日記寫下事件。

options.en: Several newspapers feature it prominently the next day.
options.zh: 翌日多份報章顯眼報道事件。

contrast.explanationZh: 私人日記不是顯眼的媒體報道。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「成為 headlines 就代表這一定是好消息，而且每家媒體都報道了。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Making headlines means prominent coverage; it need not be positive or appear in every outlet.
options.zh: 成為焦點新聞指顯眼報道，不一定是好消息，也不一定每家媒體都報。

options.en: Only positive events can ever make headlines.
options.zh: 只有正面事件能成為焦點新聞。

options.en: One headline proves every report on the topic is accurate.
options.zh: 一個標題就證明這題目下每份報道都準確。

dialogue.explanationZh: 片語只交代媒體關注度，不保證報道範圍、性質或真確性。

speaking.en: The local robotics team made headlines after its rescue device won a national design prize.
speaking.zh: 本地機械人隊的救援裝置贏得全國設計獎後，成為焦點新聞。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出引發報道的具體事情。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區義工隊設計低成本輪椅坡道，獲全市創新獎；三家本地新聞網站把它列作顯眼報道，但沒有證據說全國媒體都有報。用一至兩句英文描述其受關注程度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出坡道獲全市獎、三家本地網站顯眼報道，不要說全國每家媒體都報。

examples.en: The volunteer team’s low-cost wheelchair ramp made headlines after its citywide award, with three local news sites featuring the design prominently.
examples.zh: 義工隊的低成本輪椅坡道獲全市獎項後成為焦點新聞，三家本地新聞網站顯眼介紹這項設計。

examples.en: Three local sites gave prominent coverage to the award-winning ramp, so it made headlines locally; national coverage has not been established.
examples.zh: 三家本地網站顯眼報道這項獲獎坡道，因此它成為本地焦點新聞；目前未能證實全國媒體也有報道。

takeaways.en: Make headlines means become prominent news, not merely receive one passing mention.
takeaways.zh: 成為焦點新聞是顯眼受報道，不只是偶然被提及。

takeaways.en: Making headlines does not by itself prove the event was positive or the reports complete.
takeaways.zh: 成為焦點新聞，本身不證明事件正面或報道全面。

brief.meaningEn: Reported or discussed across many news outlets, so it is difficult to miss.
brief.meaningZh: 許多新聞媒體都在報道或討論，令人很難錯過。
brief.grammar: A story/result is or was all over the news; this describes breadth of coverage, while make headlines specifically stresses prominence.
brief.register: Everyday media conversation: a librarian explains why people had already heard about a transport change from television, radio and news sites.
brief.boundaryZh: 到處受報道不表示每個媒體都報或每項細節已核實，也不要求每則報道都是頭條。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是新聞紙實際鋪滿地面；片語的重點是廣泛曝光。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分廣泛曝光與單一顯眼頭條，並保留消息仍可能需要核實。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 70, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The result was all over the news by morning.

listening.en: By morning, the rail strike was discussed on local radio, television and several news sites. It was all over the news, though the talks were still continuing.
listening.zh: 到了早上，本地電台、電視和多個新聞網站都討論鐵路罷工。這消息到處都有報道，但談判仍在進行。
listening.promptZh: all over the news 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Many news outlets were reporting or discussing the strike.
options.zh: 許多新聞媒體在報道或討論罷工。

options.en: Only one private message mentioned the strike.
options.zh: 只有一則私人訊息提及罷工。

options.en: All negotiations were already complete.
options.zh: 所有談判都已完成。

options.en: Every report contained the same verified detail.
options.zh: 每份報道都有相同且已核實的細節。

listening.explanationZh: 電台、電視和網站都有報，說明曝光廣；談判仍未結束。

reply.promptEn: Why did the information desk receive so few questions about the museum reopening? The date had been repeated on radio, television and many local news sites for two days.
reply.promptZh: （資訊台為何很少收到博物館重開日期的查詢？日期已連續兩天在電台、電視和多個本地新聞網站重複報道。）

options.en: Many visitors could have heard the date from news reports.
options.zh: 不少訪客可能已從新聞報道得知日期。

options.en: Several kinds of outlet repeated the reopening date.
options.zh: 不同類型媒體重複報道重開日期。

options.en: The reopening date was all over the news.
options.zh: 重開日期在新聞中到處都有報道。

options.en: The widespread coverage may have answered visitors’ main question.
options.zh: 廣泛報道可能已解答訪客最主要的疑問。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以多個渠道反覆報道解釋資訊普及；金句用 all over the news。

scene.promptZh: 一個新公園開放日期在多個電台和新聞網站反覆出現，但未必登上頭條。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The opening date is all over the news even if it is not every outlet’s lead story.
options.zh: 開放日期在新聞中廣泛出現，雖未必是每家媒體的頭條。

options.en: The date has appeared in no public report.
options.zh: 日期完全未見於公開報道。

options.en: Every outlet has made it its single biggest headline.
options.zh: 每家媒體都把它列為最大頭條。

scene.explanationZh: 廣泛報道不等於每家媒體都列為首要新聞。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 a story is all over the news？

options.en: It appears repeatedly on regional radio and news sites.
options.zh: 它反覆出現在地區電台與新聞網站。

options.en: One person mentions it only in a private letter.
options.zh: 只有一人在私人信件提及它。

options.en: Television, radio and online news all discuss it.
options.zh: 電視、電台和網上新聞都在討論它。

contrast.explanationZh: 私人信件不是新聞媒體的廣泛報道。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「消息 all over the news，所以每項細節一定已核實。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: It is all over the news, but wide coverage alone does not verify each detail.
options.zh: 消息廣泛受報道，但單憑曝光率不能證實每項細節。

options.en: Many reports guarantee that every detail is correct.
options.zh: 很多媒體報道就保證每個細節正確。

options.en: If details still need checking, the story cannot be widely reported.
options.zh: 細節若仍要核實，消息便不可能廣泛受報道。

dialogue.explanationZh: 報道範圍與資料核實程度不同。

speaking.en: The election timetable was all over the news this week, so volunteers prepared answers to questions about the dates.
speaking.zh: 本週新聞廣泛報道選舉時間表，因此義工準備好回答日期查詢。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出義工為何預計有人提問。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一項渡輪班次改動在地區電台、電視和四個新聞網站連續兩天被報道；新時間表下週才生效。用一至兩句英文描述報道範圍及生效時間，不要說改動已經實施。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出多個媒體反覆報道、改動下週才生效，並避免說每家媒體都列作頭條。

examples.en: The ferry timetable change was all over the news for two days, appearing on local radio, television and four news sites, but it will not take effect until next week.
examples.zh: 渡輪班次改動連續兩天在新聞中廣泛出現，見於本地電台、電視和四個新聞網站，但要到下週才生效。

examples.en: Local radio, television and four sites covered the ferry change repeatedly, so it was all over the news; the new schedule starts next week.
examples.zh: 本地電台、電視和四個網站反覆報道渡輪改動，因此新聞到處都有提及；新時間表下週開始。

takeaways.en: All over the news means wide coverage across outlets, not necessarily a lead headline everywhere.
takeaways.zh: 新聞到處都有報，指跨媒體廣泛曝光，不一定處處是頭條。

takeaways.en: A story all over the news can still have details that require checking.
takeaways.zh: 消息即使到處受報道，細節仍可能需要核實。

brief.meaningEn: For the same reason or by applying the same principle to a comparable case.
brief.meaningZh: 基於相同理由，把同一原則應用於可比較的另一情況。
brief.grammar: Sentence-level linker often at the start of the second clause, followed by a comma; it connects analogous reasoning, not an unrelated new point.
brief.register: Reasoned committee discussion: a student representative argues that the same access criterion should apply to two public school events.
brief.boundaryZh: 兩件事必須共享相關理由；不能只因都令人喜歡便硬說同樣道理。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是「同一張代幣」，也不是 therefore 式的直接因果結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能先說清共同原則，再用 by the same token 公平地推及另一個相似個案。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 70, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: By the same token, athletes can attract coverage after a major win.

listening.en: The city funds a free reading fair because everyone can enter. By the same token, a free science fair open to everyone deserves consideration under the same access rule.
listening.zh: 市政府資助免費閱讀嘉年華，因為人人可參加。同樣道理，向所有人開放的免費科學展也值得按同一參與準則考慮。
listening.promptZh: By the same token 在這裏怎樣連接兩件事？

options.en: It applies the same public-access reason to the science fair.
options.zh: 把相同的公開參與理由套用到科學展。

options.en: It says the science fair is caused by the reading fair.
options.zh: 說科學展由閱讀嘉年華直接造成。

options.en: It claims both fairs already received identical grants.
options.zh: 聲稱兩個嘉年華已獲完全相同資助。

options.en: It introduces an unrelated reason for a private event.
options.zh: 為私人活動提出一個無關的新理由。

listening.explanationZh: 兩個活動都免費向公眾開放，可按同一準則考慮。

reply.promptEn: Should the school lend the hall to the robotics club? It lent the hall to the drama club because that club admits all interested pupils and holds free after-school meetings; the robotics club does too.
reply.promptZh: （學校應借禮堂給機械人學會嗎？學校借禮堂給戲劇學會，是因為它歡迎所有有興趣學生，並免費在課後聚會；機械人學會也一樣。）

options.en: The same open-access rule supports considering both clubs.
options.zh: 相同的公開參與準則支持考慮兩個學會。

options.en: Both clubs meet the reason already used for the hall decision.
options.zh: 兩個學會都符合原有借場理由。

options.en: By the same token, the robotics club should be considered under that rule.
options.zh: 同樣道理，也應按那項準則考慮機械人學會。

options.en: The school can apply its stated criterion consistently.
options.zh: 學校可以一致地應用已表明的準則。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出同一開放準則；金句用 by the same token 連接相似個案。

scene.promptZh: 校方因學生可免費參加而批准一個講座；另一個活動也免費開放給所有學生。哪句最貼切？

options.en: By the same token, the second event merits consideration under the access criterion.
options.zh: 同樣道理，第二個活動也值得按參與準則考慮。

options.en: The first talk directly caused the second event to exist.
options.zh: 第一個講座直接造成第二個活動出現。

options.en: The second event must be funded without checking any other criteria.
options.zh: 毋須查其他準則，也必須資助第二個活動。

scene.explanationZh: 兩個活動共享免費開放的理由，但仍可檢查其他條件。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個銜接最不適合用 by the same token？

options.en: Both clubs are open to all, so the same access rule may apply.
options.zh: 兩個學會都向所有人開放，故可用同一準則。

options.en: One club is free; an unrelated bus route closed for repairs.
options.zh: 一個學會免費；另一條無關巴士路線因維修停運。

options.en: Two libraries offer the same public hours, so both qualify for the access review.
options.zh: 兩間圖書館有相同公眾開放時間，都可接受參與評估。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有共同原則可把學會與巴士停運相連。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩件事都很受歡迎，所以一定能用 by the same token 支持相同補助。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: By the same token needs a shared relevant criterion; popularity alone may not be the funding rule.
options.zh: 同樣道理要有共同的相關準則；受歡迎未必是補助規則。

options.en: Any two popular things always deserve the same funding.
options.zh: 只要都受歡迎，就必定應得相同補助。

options.en: The phrase means one event automatically causes another.
options.zh: 這片語表示一項活動自動造成另一項。

dialogue.explanationZh: 須先確認用來類比的理由確實相關。

speaking.en: The museum waives entry fees for school groups to improve access. By the same token, it could consider waiving fees for local youth clubs under the same access goal.
speaking.zh: 博物館為了方便參與，免收學校團體門票。同樣道理，也可按同一目標考慮豁免本地青年團體的費用。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出兩類團體共享的目標。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區基金給免費、向所有居民開放的園藝課程場地補貼；一個同樣免費並向所有居民開放的烹飪課程申請相同補貼，但仍須完成一般審核。用一至兩句英文以相同參與準則作類比，不要說已批准第二個申請。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出園藝課程已獲補貼、兩課都免費且開放、烹飪課仍待審核。

examples.en: The free gardening class received a venue subsidy because it is open to all residents. By the same token, the free cooking class deserves review under that access rule, though approval is still pending.
examples.zh: 免費園藝課程因向所有居民開放而獲場地補貼。同樣道理，免費烹飪課程也值得按參與準則審核，但批准仍待決定。

examples.en: The fund supported the open, free gardening class; by the same token, it should consider the equally open cooking class for the subsidy, without treating the application as approved yet.
examples.zh: 基金資助了免費開放的園藝課程；同樣道理，也應考慮同樣開放的烹飪課程，但目前不能當作申請已獲批。

takeaways.en: By the same token carries one relevant reason from one case to a comparable case.
takeaways.zh: 同樣道理，是把相關理由用於可比較的另一個案。

takeaways.en: By the same token does not mean the second application is automatically approved.
takeaways.zh: 同樣道理不代表第二份申請自動獲批。
